authored.label: Kuhn Landscape
authored.lineage: The ten family colours of the Landscape of Consciousness figure, lifted for a night sky; obsidian for Challenge drawn as silver light.

intent.use: a navigable map of theories of consciousness

rules.name: Complete sentence
rules.need: 0 missing tokens

rules.name: Labels are legible
rules.need: contrast >= 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.x)
rules.note: ink on ground and on plate

rules.name: Figure separates from ground
rules.need: Delta E OK >= 0.1, or an edge with contrast >= 1.6:1, or a light (L >= 0.5) lit surface with shadow + contact >= 0.8

rules.name: Categories are distinct
rules.need: min pair Delta E OK >= 0.08; >= 0.04 under deutan and protan

rules.name: Order reads as order
rules.need: monotone OKLab lightness, span >= 0.3

rules.name: Alert pops out
rules.need: Delta E OK >= 0.15 from every body and the plate

rules.name: Accents are scarce
rules.need: <= 0.15 of marks

rules.name: Glow needs night
rules.need: ground OKLab L <= 0.35
rules.note: a glow on a bright ground is only a flat colour

rules.name: Light agrees with surface
rules.need: lit surface has a key light

rules.name: Air agrees with sky
rules.need: haze within Delta E OK 0.08 of the horizon
rules.note: else distant masses silhouette in the wrong colour

rules.name: Motion is restrained
rules.need: pulse period >= 0.5 s (under 3 flashes a second, WCAG 2.3.1)

rules.name: Plate is a quiet step
rules.need: Delta E OK from the ground in 0.02..0.2

rules.name: Palette is portable
rules.need: >= 4 categorical and >= 3 sequential stops
rules.note: so transposition always has what it needs

rules.name: Declared key is honest
rules.need: intent.key low: L <= 0.4, mid: 0.3..0.85, high: >= 0.75
